description: This file defines the 'TimesheetActionLog' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the database table 'ohrm_timesheet_action_log'. It includes properties for log ID, action, comment, date, user who performed the action, and related timesheet, along with their getter and setter methods, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet action log entry within the OrangeHRM system, with properties for ID, action, comment, date, performing user, and associated timesheet.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the timesheet action log.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the timesheet action log.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns optional comment regarding the action.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets an optional comment regarding the action.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the action was performed.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the action was performed.

methods.name: getPerformedUser
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedUser
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates a timesheet with this log entry.
